reports.title: The Trade Desk Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue flat at $736m, well above estimates; Q4 outlook of at least $755m
results: Revenue slipped 0.5% to $736m but came in well above the $651m analysts expected.
Adjusted EPS fell to $0.33 from $0.45 (GAAP $0.08 from $0.23) as costs rose and a $44m restructuring charge was booked.
Adjusted EBITDA dropped 16% to $266m and the margin narrowed to 36% from 43%.
The board added $731m to the buyback, taking capacity to $1bn; no shares were bought in Q3.
Cash and short-term investments stood at about $1.65bn, with no debt.

guidance.summary: The Trade Desk guided Q4 revenue of at least $755m and adjusted EBITDA of at least $280m. It gives no full-year outlook.

points: The CEO said Q3 beat the company's August outlook but growth is still well below what it expects of itself.
About 3 points of Q3 growth came from a strategic partner and is not expected to repeat.
Q4 guidance assumes no normal seasonal lift because some large global advertisers are spending less; autos and consumer goods are weak.
About 15% of staff were cut; management expects over $100m of gross savings in 2027, partly reinvested in AI and measurement.
Management pitched its independence from Amazon and Google, and pointed to the Kokai Zuma upgrade and a deeper Netflix tie-up.
call.source: Call transcript: The Trade Desk (TTD) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — The Motley Fool, 10 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Q4 revenue returns to growth and clears the $755m floor.
Spending trends among large advertisers, especially autos and consumer goods.
Delivery of the restructuring savings and use of the enlarged $1bn buyback.
